notes.title: New free update: Mindform Ascend: New features, new challenges, new heights!
notes.notes:
Embark on a New Adventure!
The long-awaited Ascend Update for Mindform is live! This update brings exciting new content, improved gameplay mechanics, and several bug fixes. Let’s dive into what’s new in the world of Mindform!

[h2]Neuroasis Hub[/h2]
The Neuroasis Hub acts as your new starting point, connecting all game modes and providing a serene yet exciting environment to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888070/d5c02f25163b8ee65d6d7d94085cd3d27ccd1cd8.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Music & Sound Effects[/h3]
Immerse yourself with an updated soundtrack and fresh sound effects, enhancing the climbing experience.

[h1]New Game Modes[/h1]
[list]
[*]     One Minute Mode: See how far you can climb in just 60 seconds!
[*]     Arcade Mode: Challenge yourself with specific routes and mechanics.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888070/c942094d461ce3cc42d995f7483b166809f5aab4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Controller Support & Steam Input[/h2]
Play Mindform the way you want! Full controller support and Steam Input integration make the experience more flexible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888070/33e28217ac3922dc4485cac0a6f15ef7c3087966.jpg[/img]

[h1]Gameplay Enhancements[/h1]
New Routes to Climb
Discover and master brand-new climbing routes, each offering unique challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888070/4c7f303157f83c4858302378b2a505d94b67cb93.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

    Resolved issues with player resets, void teleportation, and menu navigation.
    Fixed sound bugs and issues with the highlight function.

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*]     Improved occlusion culling for better performance.
[*]     Updated lighting and cloud generation for stunning visuals.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888070/d5c02f25163b8ee65d6d7d94085cd3d27ccd1cd8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Free Mindform update: Ascend – New trial mode, controller support and more.
notes.notes:
[h1]Big [b]free update Incoming[/b] on December 13th![/h1]

Get ready for a game-changing experience in Mindform! This [b]free update[/b] brings fresh challenges, new ways to explore, and exciting compatibility enhancements. Here’s what’s coming your way:

[h2]1-Minute trial mode - perfect for speedrunners! [/h2]
Can you conquer the new mountain level faster than anyone else? In the new 1-Minute trial, start at the bottom, race to the top, and aim for the high score. With only 60 seconds, every move counts! Take on the leaderboard and prove you’re the fastest climber in Mindform!

[h2]Explore the Neuroasis Hub [Beta][/h2]
Step into the [b]"Neuroasis Hub"[/b], your gateway to all things [b]Mindform[/b]! In this new hub area, you can dive into different levels, try out fresh game modes, and start exploring. Be on the lookout for secrets and hidden areas that await adventurous players. And in a later update, you’ll be able to meet friends and tackle challenges together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888070/3869dfa70391f58aed6c756312dce819b08023be.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Steam Deck[/b] playable + Controller support[/h2]
We’re excited to officially support Steam Deck! As huge believers in Valve’s vision, Gametrain Studios is making Mindform fully playable on Steam Deck. This also means Mindform now includes full controller support, a feature many of you have requested. Get ready to play [b]your way! [/b]

[i]Sidenote: We're to small a studio to apply for the deck verification. As soon as that is possible we'll be making sure that everything goes through accordingly :) In the meantime we will make sure everything runs smooth as butter through proton and that the game plays and controls like intended for the smaller screen size.
[/i]
Mark your calendar for [b]December 13th[/b] and join us for this massive [b]free "Ascend" update.[/b] Get set to climb, explore, and play Mindform like never before. See you on the mountain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888070/33e28217ac3922dc4485cac0a6f15ef7c3087966.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update to V.1.0.1 - Menu patch
notes.notes:
Thank you very much to all the feedback from the players which help is in furthering the development of this game! Please continue to send it in.

[b]Change log[/b]

Fixed:
[list]
[*] Hold detection on moments without target in front of hands
[*] Several dialog bugs
[*] Problem where save could reset to previous level
[*] Problem where Menu would reset 
[*] Problem where using 'esc' to close the settings menu it closed the main menu too.
[/list]

Updated:
[list]
[*] Settings menu in start menu
[*] Several updates to fog settings to improve performance
[*] Floor heights in the first stages
[*] Small tweaks to tutorial and level one routes
[/list]

notes.title: Mindform V.1.0 release!
notes.notes:
Imagine the fantasy of becoming an (e)sports world champion. Embark on this journey through a first-person climbing game set within the depths of your mind. Feel the exhilaration of overcoming challenges and scaling new heights. Unearth your inner strength and delve into the mindset of a true champion. Prepare to push your boundaries and discover the champion within you.

We just released Mindform on steam! Thank you all so very much for making this milestone possible, we couldn't make it without your ongoing support!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2572990/Mindform/]Mindform on steam![/url]

Buy it now while it's hot! We have many more updates planned. See you on the climbing range!
We highly value your feedback, so please let us know what you think and help us make the game even better.

[b]Change Log[/b]

Fixed:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with dialog progress resetting each level
[*] Fixed bug where dialog text would not match audio
[*] Fixed Quality resetting on restart
[*] Fixed bug where the hands would be able to spawn inside the walls
[/list]

Added:
[list]
[*] Added new intro scene
[*] Added Quality settings; "low", "med", "high", and "ultra"
[/list]

Updated:
[list]
[*] Tutorial routes
[*] Hand hold targeting
[/list]

notes.title: Update to V.0.8.0 - Optimization and Lighting
notes.notes:
We're currently working hard on the main game making sure everything is as good as possible for the release.  It's a very exciting time and we are looking forward to what you guys think on release!

This update focusses mainly on optimization were as future patches will be focusing more on the gameplay and overall feel of the game.

[b]Added / Removed :
[/b][list]
[*] Added Steam Achievements
[*] Added all levels to separate scenes to minimize GameObjects per scene
[*] Removed intro movie
[/list]
[b]Updated : 
[/b][list]
[*] Updated shaders to let player highlight holds with "H"
[*] Updated lighting
[*] Updated fog settings
[*] Updated several routes
[*] Updated various GameObjects in each level
[*] Optimized Occlusion culling
[*] Optimized lighting settings
[/list]
[b]Fixed :
[/b][list]
[*] Fixed bug where player would CTD on loading the next level
[*] Fixed bug where player would spawn in walls
[*] Fixed bug where players "R" reset teleport would teleport them to the wrong position
[/list]

notes.title: Blood, Sweat and Rocks. Test your determination with our free demo!
notes.notes:
[h1]Free demo, out now![/h1]

We are finally releasing something into the wild and didn´t even have the time to post an announcement about the demo. Turns out that the demo has already been downloaded thousands of times! Thank you so much for this, you could not have made us happier!

As the title says, go and "Test your determination!" Play the demo, we would love to see all of your feedback and consider supporting this little project of ours by purchasing Mindform when it hits Steam's store shelves! 

[h2]About the first early access release: [/h2]
We are at the final stages of optimizing for lower spec hardware, we'll have an update real soon! This 0.1 release will include more singleplayer "story" elements. We are convinced that when you are able to finish it you'll be ready to start learning.

[h2]Arcade mode?[/h2]
In the update following this release we're aiming to add an "arcade mode". This means endless climbing fun and frustration. but this will also be the foundation of the training data gathering and improvement systems.

[h2]Next time on Mindform[/h2]
I won´t go to much in detail, I have a habit of spoiling to much. I can´t wait to show you what we have in store next!
